name: First Custodian Fund(I) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, First Custodian Fund Ltd provides brokerage services and deals in shares & securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
FCFL is a member of NSE and registered as
 a Stock Broker by carrying on the business in brokerage in shares. Company is engaged in lease and hire purchase activities and deals capital markets as an investor in shares and 
 also trades in futures & options

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 398 to 108 days.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 9.39% over last 3 years.
